message: I remember the last time we had a power outage—it was a chilly evening, and the lights went out just as I was settling in with a cup of tea. Instead of panicking, I grabbed my trusty flashlight and some cozy blankets, and we turned it into a little adventure. We huddled together, powered up some snacks with a portable charger, and shared stories by lantern light. It reminded me that even when the power's out, we can still create warmth and connection. Have you turned a blackout into a cozy event?
